description: Signed-in accounts: save a topic x purpose search so get_podcast_topic_changes can report podcasts that newly match it. Records the current matches as the baseline, so get_podcast_topic_changes returns only shows that appear after now. Returns the watch_id.

purpose.description: What you want from the show: 'guest' (book someone onto it) or 'sponsor' (advertise on it). Routes designated for this purpose rank first.

require_route.description: Only report shows that have a contact route for this purpose. Default false.

topic.description: The topic to watch, as for find_podcast_contacts.

name: watch_podcast_topic
title: Watch Podcast Topic
